product_ref: required; your own id for the line; rows sharing one are variants of it
product_name: required; the line, as a shopper would see it
sku: required; unique per row; what everybody outside your systems says
variant_name: required; what distinguishes this row from its siblings
is_base: required; true on exactly one row per product reference
category: required; one of the codes on the Categories sheet
claims: optional; one entry per cell, separated by '|'
compliance.certificate_ref: optional; applies to general.diy.handtools, general.diy.paint, general.garden.bbq, general.garden.tools, and 2 more only
compliance.min_age: optional; safety - a person reviews any change; applies to general.diy.handtools only; the number only, in years - never '65 years'
compliance.sale_permitted: optional; safety - a person reviews any change; true or false
identifiers.gtin: required by CH-MKT-A, CH-MKT-B; 14 digits, kept as text - leading zeros are significant
pack.net_quantity: optional; applies to general.diy.paint, general.pet.accessories, general.pet.dogfood only
pack.unit: optional; applies to general.diy.paint, general.pet.accessories, general.pet.dogfood only
specs.battery_type: optional; safety - a person reviews any change; applies to general.toys.games, general.toys.outdoor only
image.HERO: required; the file name as it appears in images/ inside the bundle
image.DETAIL: optional; the file name as it appears in images/ inside the bundle
example_note: ignored on the way in; delete the column or leave it
MISSING_MANDATORY - identifiers.gtin is blank, and a channel refuses the listing without it
FOREIGN_VOCABULARY - this row is fine, but a file whose header reads 'netContent' instead of 'pack.net_quantity' is rejected with the column named. Rename the column to see it
BROKEN_FORMAT - a 13-character GTIN with a letter in it, which is what a spreadsheet export produces when the column was typed as text and edited by hand
MISSING_MEDIA - image.HERO is blank, and this category cannot launch without it
